newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran quake toll rises to 930 - official agency.
newsitem.headline: Iran quake toll rises to 930 - official agency.

text.p: The death toll in an earthquake which rocked eastern Iran on Saturday rose to 930, the Iranian news agency IRNA reported.

Some 130 villagers had died in the vicinity of the town of Birjand in addition to more than 800 who were killed in the area of Qaen, said the agency monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation. Both towns are near the epicentre of the quake which measured 7.1 on the Richter scale.

There was confusion over the number of people injured. IRNA earlier said 5,000 people were injured by the quake but state-run Tehran radio put the figure at 40,000 and Iranian television said the number was in the thousands.
The radio said there was a dire need for medical and surgical personnel, medicine, blood, tents, food, ambulances, heavy earth-moving equipment and helicopters.
It said electricity and water supplies had been cut off to villages in the quake zone and water and other relief equipment were being transported to the region.
The radio said 80 villages were levelled and 70 suffered 60 percent damage.
